instruction: A candid documentary medium close-up of three women laughing on an outdoor rooftop terrace. On the left, a woman in a black sleeveless top (R4) cheers excitedly with a raised hand and a wide smile. In the center, a dark-haired woman (R3) wearing a striped top claps and laughs heartily. On the right, a woman with a curly afro (R7) in a striped dress laughs joyfully, looking towards her friends. They stand close together against a brick wall background under bright, natural daylight.
elements: R4 cheers excitedly with a raised hand and wide smile
R7 laughs joyfully while looking toward her friends
R4 cheers while R3 claps nearby
R7 attends to her friends as they laugh together
outdoor rooftop terrace with a brick wall under bright natural daylight
